buttons.label: Resume behavior
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'wire-a') { actor.testPlayClip(null); } }

buttons.label: Bell confusion
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'wire-a') { actor.onBellRung({eventId: Date.now(), duration: 2}); } }

buttons.label: Ring counter bell
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === "wire-counter-bell") { actor.beginRinging(); actor.strike(); actor.endRinging(); } }

buttons.label: Gremlin view
buttons.script: const actor=[...objects].find(o=>o.definition?.id==='wire-a'); camera.setViewport({zoom:6,rotation:2,panX:actor.position.x+1.5,panZ:actor.position.z-1.5});

buttons.label: Castle view
buttons.script: camera.setViewport({zoom: 4, rotation: 2, panX: -1, panZ: -4});

buttons.label: Hold rival idle
buttons.script: [...objects].find(o=>o.definition?.id==='wire-b').testPlayClip('idle');

buttons.label: Carry with hero
buttons.script: const actor=[...objects].find(o=>o.definition?.id==='wire-a'); actor.beginCarry(actor.runtime.getHero());

buttons.label: Throw into tower
buttons.script: const actor=[...objects].find(o=>o.definition?.id==='wire-a'); const tower=[...objects].find(o=>o.definition?.id==='wire-tower'); const model=tower.visualRoots[0].children[0]; const p=model.getWorldTransform().transformPoint(new actor.pc.Vec3(-0.55,0.3,0)); const flight=(2-actor.radius-0.3)/4; const vy=0.45/flight+Math.abs(actor.app.systems.rigidbody.gravity.y)*flight/2; actor.releaseTarget(); actor.entity.rigidbody.enabled=true; actor.entity.rigidbody.teleport(p.x,p.y,p.z+2); actor.launch({velocity:{x:0,y:vy,z:-4}});

buttons.label: Miss onto lawn
buttons.script: const actor=[...objects].find(o=>o.definition?.id==='wire-a'); actor.releaseTarget(); actor.entity.rigidbody.enabled=true; actor.entity.rigidbody.teleport(-8,3.5,-12); actor.launch({velocity:{x:0,y:2,z:0}});

buttons.label: Half speed
buttons.script: [...objects].find(o=>o.definition?.id==='wire-a').app.timeScale=0.5;

buttons.label: Normal speed
buttons.script: [...objects].find(o=>o.definition?.id==='wire-a').app.timeScale=1;

buttons.label: Toggle collision trace
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'wire-a') actor.definition.recordEvidence = !actor.definition.recordEvidence; }
